Profile.Profile:
photo-cleanup sorts out a large photo archive on the machine that holds it. It finds the versions of one photograph — an exact copy, a smaller export, a raw with the camera JPEG beside it — and says which is which rather than calling them all duplicates. It tells a burst of frames from a duplicate and helps pick the keeper. It accounts for Lightroom previews and caches, which can always be made again. And it can sort what is left by date.
Nothing is deleted without a confirmation: files move to a hidden quarantine folder on the same disk, which is instant and reversible, and space returns only after a separate permanent deletion. Everything runs locally, with no internet involved. The interface is in English or Russian.
